_comment: Pinned PSID FAMILY registry (Stage 0.1) — canonical_name -> FAMILY. Derive-once, pin-forever: assign_substance_uids() reads this first so an InChIKey correction, rename, or re-fold never moves an existing substance's identity; only genuinely-new substances mint and are appended. A 14-letter value is an InChIKey block 1; a leading-digit value is a name-hash (structure-less row or distinct-collision member). Generated by pipeline/build/sqlite.py; edit only to intentionally re-pin. See pipeline/psid.py and Specs/stereoisomer-and-release-form-axes.md.
